title: Santa's Workshop 14" North Pole Elf Nutcracker

comparisons.notes: 14 inch North Pole Elf Nutcracker; product description word-for-word the same as Santa's Workshop's copy for model 70200; page says 'In stock, ready to ship'.

writeup: Santa's Workshop's North Pole Elf nutcracker (model 70200) is a 14-inch hand-painted wooden elf holding a North Pole signpost. Woot has it brand new for $21.99, while Pier 1 sells the same nutcracker for $65, so you save about $43. Woot limits it to 3 per customer and stock looks thin.
amazon_match_notes: Verified exact match by checker: Santa's Workshop model 70200 / UPC 661565702008.
